thread:
Lena: hi team 1 confiding here. i was assaulted outside the office over the weekend and will need a combination of time off, a physical workspace change, and a temporary reassignment from customer-facing oncall tasks. i'm nervous about the review cycle coming up and want to ensure this doesn't get reflected negatively. what are our immediate options?

Marcus - Manager: Lena, i'm really sorry. take whatever time you need this week. we'll pause scheduled demos and shift customer escalations to Marcus backup rotation. i'll work with People Ops to formalize a safety plan.

Tess - People Ops: Lena 1 i'm so sorry that happened. we have an incident support protocol: 1) immediate safety accommodations (alternate workspace, escorts, temporary remote work), 2) time off and EAP referrals, 3) confidential accommodation plan for duties like oncall, 4) limited disclosure to manager + HR. we can also put a hiring freeze on new customer assignments for 30 days. would you like a private call now?

Lena: yes please. i prefer remote for two weeks and a new desk location when i'm back. i also want reduced oncall exposure for 2 months. i don't think i can do the upcoming product demo.

Omar - HR: we can record the accommodations as a confidential letter and adjust review weighting. provider note optional; EAP documentation can be provided if you want support in getting notes. everything will be kept in the secure HR file.

Priya - HR: if you want, we can also start a temporary reassignment for customer-facing tasks and give you project work that is PD (product dev) focused. we'll make sure it's reflected as "temporary redeployment" in internal notes, not as a performance issue.

Marcus - Manager: i'll message the demo owner to postpone. Jordan and Keiko, can you cover the live demo?

Lena: thank you. i'll take 3 days of paid leave and then see how i feel. also would like to request a safety escort for the first day back.

Tess - People Ops: noted. drafting accommodation letter now. sample wording: "Temporary reassignment from customer-facing duties, remote-first for 2 weeks, alternate onsite desk, reduced oncall (1 week/month) for 2 months, EAP counseling referral." you can edit before sign-off.

Lena: that wording is fine. i appreciate the support and speed here.

Omar - HR: next steps: 1) sign off on accommodation letter, 2) implement remote status + desk move, 3) update oncall rota and review weighting, 4) schedule 1:1 with People Ops in 2 weeks to reassess.

Marcus - Manager: please let me know if you want me included in any conversations with security, or if you prefer People Ops handle it.

Lena: keep me in the loop but limit people on the thread. DM'ing Tess now.

Tess - People Ops: DM incoming and sending the draft. we'll treat this as confidential and store it in HR's secure record. support resources: EAP number, security escort, and local police liaison if needed. :lock:
